title: An added batch exceeds the verification deadline
root_cause: The workflow adds the archive batch to the existing matrix entry, so both batches run sequentially in one job. Each takes about 345 seconds, and together they exceed the unchanged ten-minute job timeout.

relevant_evidence.why: The job passes both batches to its sequential loop.
The first batch takes nearly six minutes and the job times out during the second.
The matrix entry contains both batches and the job has a ten-minute limit.
